entries.text: JoinOrder DataFrame queries now join the most selective tables first, apply every join predicate as a join key instead of filtering a larger intermediate afterwards, and read only the columns a query uses. At scale 1 the Polars power phase peaks near 5 GiB instead of 9 GiB and finishes in 3 minutes instead of 7, and DataFusion peaks near 2.5 GiB instead of exceeding 7 GiB and the 20 minute cell limit.
